title: Senior Python Backend Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Backend Engineer to join our growing team in Cairo. You will design and build scalable microservices using FastAPI and Django REST Framework. Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and AWS is required. You will lead technical discussions, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of Python experience
- Strong knowledge of FastAPI or Django
- PostgreSQL and Redis
- Docker and Kubernetes
- AWS or GCP cloud experience
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Nice to have:
- GraphQL experience
- Experience with Apache Kafka
- Open source contributions

title: Full Stack Developer (React + Node.js)
description:
Join our Cairo-based team building modern web applications. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer proficient in React.js and Node.js with experience in TypeScript.

You will work on client-facing dashboards and APIs serving thousands of users.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of full-stack development
- React.js with TypeScript
- Node.js and Express
- MongoDB or PostgreSQL
- Git and agile workflows

Nice to have:
- Next.js experience
- AWS or Azure
- GraphQL

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. This is a great opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment.

Requirements:
- 1+ year of experience or strong internship background
- Python or JavaScript
- Basic SQL knowledge
- Familiarity with Git
- Strong problem-solving skills

Nice to have:
- Django or Flask experience
- React.js basics
- REST API design knowledge

title: Remote Python Engineer — Worldwide
description:
We are a fully distributed company hiring Python engineers from anywhere in the world. We build developer tools and APIs used by thousands of developers globally.

Requirements:
- 3+ years Python
- FastAPI or Django REST Framework
- PostgreSQL
- Experience with async Python (asyncio, aiohttp)
- Strong written English for async collaboration

We welcome applicants from all countries including Egypt, Africa, Eastern Europe, and Latin America.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Join our AI research team to build and deploy ML models for NLP and computer vision tasks. You will work closely with data scientists and software engineers to bring models from prototype to production.

Requirements:
- Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn)
- TensorFlow or PyTorch
- Experience with model serving (FastAPI, TorchServe, or TF Serving)
- Docker and basic Kubernetes
- 3+ years ML engineering

Nice to have:
- MLflow or Kubeflow
- Transformers/Hugging Face
- Apache Spark experience

title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
We offer a 3-month paid internship for final-year CS students or recent graduates. You will work on real projects under the guidance of senior engineers.

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a CS/Engineering degree
- Python or JavaScript fundamentals
- Curiosity and eagerness to learn
- Basic Git knowledge

No prior professional experience required.

title: Lead Backend Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Lead Backend Engineer to head our payments infrastructure team. You will own the architecture of our core payment processing systems, mentor a team of 5 engineers, and drive technical strategy.

Requirements:
- 8+ years of backend engineering
- Python (Django, FastAPI) and/or Go
- PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
- Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
- Strong leadership and communication skills
- Experience with PCI-DSS compliance or financial systems

title: Frontend Developer (React.js)
description:
We are looking for a React.js developer to build beautiful, performant user interfaces for our SaaS products.

Requirements:
- 2+ years React.js experience
- TypeScript
- CSS/SCSS, responsive design
- REST API integration
- Git and code review culture

Nice to have:
- Next.js
- Redux or Zustand
- Figma to code workflow

title: DevOps / Platform Engineer — Remote
description:
Remote position open to candidates worldwide. We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to manage our infrastructure, automate deployment pipelines, and ensure reliability.

Requirements:
- Kubernetes (EKS or GKE)
- Terraform and infrastructure as code
- Docker
- CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
- AWS or GCP
- Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana

Open to applicants from all locations including Africa, Middle East, Asia.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Build and maintain data pipelines for our analytics platform. You will work with large datasets, design ETL processes, and ensure data quality and reliability.

Requirements:
- Python (Pandas, PySpark)
- SQL (PostgreSQL or BigQuery)
- Apache Airflow
- AWS S3, Glue, or similar
- dbt experience preferred

Location: Cairo — hybrid (3 days office)

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js) — Remote Africa
description:
Remote position open to candidates based in Africa. We build fintech solutions for the African market.

Requirements:
- Node.js (Express, NestJS)
- TypeScript
- PostgreSQL
- Redis
- REST and GraphQL APIs

Applicants must be located in Africa for timezone alignment.

title: Senior React / Next.js Developer — Remote
description:
We are a product studio building SaaS applications and are looking for a senior frontend engineer. Fully remote, open to worldwide applicants.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of React experience
- Next.js App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS or styled-components
- Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals)
- REST/GraphQL APIs

We hire from any country with a reliable internet connection.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
We need a QA Automation Engineer to build and maintain our test suites for web and mobile applications.

Requirements:
- Selenium or Playwright
- Python or JavaScript for test scripting
- API testing (Postman, pytest)
- CI/CD integration
- SQL basics

Location: Cairo, hybrid.

title: Platform Engineer (US Only — not eligible for Egypt)
description: Looking for a Platform Engineer in the United States only. Must be authorized to work in the US. Not open to remote international applicants.

title: Python Developer (Django) — Egypt Remote
description:
Fully remote position for Egypt-based developers. We build e-commerce and marketplace solutions using Django.

Requirements:
- 2+ years Django
- Django REST Framework
- PostgreSQL
- Celery and Redis
- Basic Docker knowledge

Must be based in Egypt.
